scope: BUDGET-LIMITED: Adam (not SOAP), ~22k steps on an L4 (not 100k on A100; 2nd-order autograd ~3.6 step/s), trimmed collocation, no trainable activations; QRes + RBF + RAR + causality. Tests whether the ModPINN architecture improves over 137 at an L4-feasible budget, NOT the paper's accuracy.
verdict: FULL ModPINN: subcritical field relL2_Phi 0.363 (vs 136 plain 0.62, 137 Fourier-lite 0.497) -- the QRes + RBF + residual-adaptive-sampling components approaches the quantitative <0.20 gate, with the dichotomy preserved (sub max 2m/r 0.024 disperses, super 0.974 collapses, FD 0.980). The ModPINN architecture partially closes the accuracy gap the plain-MLP/Fourier-lite PINNs left -- the global physics-in-loss paradigm reaches improved accuracy on the collapse, all without rollout.
